An uncommon promotional demonstration album produced by Jenson Publications for band directors and music educators. This two-record set features excerpts and performances of symphonic band, concert band, classics for concert band, young band, and basic band literature intended for educational review and music selection.

A unique piece of educational music history and a great addition for collectors of promotional records, school band memorabilia, or music education materials.
